entities.name: Valdivia Culture: The Americas' Oldest Pottery
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Valdivia culture of Ecuador's Santa Elena Peninsula produced the oldest known pottery in the Americas (c. 3500–3200 BCE), challenging theories that ceramics diffused from Asia.
